newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Metway says no comment CEO report.
newsitem.headline: Metway says no comment CEO report.

text.p: Metway Bank Ltd said on Monday it was too early to comment on a newspaper report that a new chief executive had been appointed for the banking group to be created by the merger of Metway, Suncorp Insurance and Finance and Queensland Industry Development Corp (QIDC).

Metway's general manager of public affairs, Cliff Dawson, told Reuters he would make no comment on a report in the Courier-Mail newspaper in Brisbane that Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd's New Zealand managing director, Steve Jones, had been appointed to the position.
The newspaper said the appointment of Jones, previously managing director of ANZ's retail operations, was expected to be announced later on Monday.
It said Jones had been with ANZ since 1990 and had been head of the bank's New Zealand operations for the past two years.
